sources.title: Dolichol synthesis defects: a cautionary note on the use of statins
sources.access_scope: Three-page author manuscript from institutional repository retrieved live through Firecrawl PDF extraction; DOI cross-reference in R25-N03.
sources.supports: One DHDDS p.K42E patient's reversible edema/skin symptoms with four statins and no retinal worsening; causality uncertain; authors mention unpublished lovastatin-sensitive glycosylation observations in SRD5A3/DHRSX cells.
sources.does_not_establish: Causal mechanism, atorvastatin harm in SRD5A3, or a replicated disease-specific safety signal. Unpublished cell observations are not a fully reviewed dataset.
